baseline.holdoutRule: All previously exposed images, including the five v23 holdouts, are regression cases. After candidate code and labels are frozen, select new pixel-reviewed holdouts with at least two return_point truths and at least two non-return_point truths. Each holdout must pass every classification, action and safety assertion with zero provider errors. Apply the ordered v23 rules to the submitted pixels: an identified non-beverage keeps its ordinary channel in any scene, and drinks follow the container-category rules. Image exactness remains at least 95%, return-point recall at least 90%, and wrong non-null channels and false return points remain zero tolerance. Reject near-duplicate source pairs at 0.995 before any model call. These checks are developer-visible, frozen and non-adaptive, not sealed blind tests.

invariants: Route a single intact, uncontaminated prepackaged plastic or metal drink bottle, can or cup to return_point by container category. Capacity only excludes: a stated or visible capacity outside 150ml-3L routes to blue_bin, and an unknown capacity withholds nothing.

Glass, cartons, pouches, non-beverages, powdered drinks, food for special medical purposes and freshly prepared drinks are outside the deposit category.
